Likely root cause: boundary check wrong. If token valid through expiry instant, reject only when:

```js
currentTime > expiry
```

But you say code already uses that. Then likely hidden issue:

- `currentTime` in ms
- `expiry` in seconds (`jwt exp` usually seconds)

Fix:

```js
const currentTime = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)

if (currentTime > expiry) {
  reject()
}
```

If policy follows JWT spec, token expires when `now >= exp`, so exact boundary is invalid:

```js
if (currentTime >= expiry) {
  reject()
}
```
